# Justin Grant, UX Designer and Researcher

> UX designer who starts with research. Designs complex AI and data tools for the people who depend on them: interaction design, information architecture, service design, prototyping in Figma and in code. Research at every stage: generative, formative, and summative. Work across open-source AI, education, enterprise tools, and HR compliance.

Website: https://justingrant.design/
Contact: https://justingrant.design/#contact
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/justgrant5/

## Case studies
- [Mozilla Data Collective: finding what an ethical data platform needed next](https://justingrant.design/mdc.html): two rapid research rounds on the LLM Data Assistant (30, then 10 participants) that changed the interface and the model before launch, site architecture, data access controls, data quality signals, services marketplace, pricing market research across 200+ datasets, and a demand survey with a false door. Platform: 600+ datasets, 190+ vetted organizations, 300+ languages.
- [McGraw Hill ALEKS: the usability tests said it was fine, the classroom said otherwise](https://justingrant.design/aleks.html): classroom contextual inquiry in a regional study with 100+ teachers, checked against 10,000+ survey responses. Real-time signals in the teacher dashboard, usability score up from 73 to 82 (UMUX-Lite), and manual override of AI assignments added to the roadmap.
- [Indeed: the risk was in how work flowed, not in the technology](https://justingrant.design/indeed.html): 100+ interviews, contextual inquiries and usability tests behind an executive-approved phased plan to move 7,000 users to Jira Cloud. Service blueprint and journey map recreated.
- [Mozilla Common Voice: fixing bad voice data before it's recorded](https://justingrant.design/common-voice.html): Spontaneous Speech, a 0-to-1 product for unscripted speech. Shipped in 58 languages; 62 language datasets in release 2.0.
- [hrsimple.com: making employment law readable, and worth paying for](https://justingrant.design/hrsimple.html): eight years, from sales to UX designer and developer. 10,000+ paying clients; staff workload cut 75 percent; B2B pipeline doubled to $1.6M.
